The initiative includes imposing fines amounting to Rs 5.13 crore and the termination of contracts. By conducting regular inspections and surprise checks, they aim to enhance food safety compliance. The introduction of modern base kitchens, along with the installation of CCTV cameras, is intended for vigilant monitoring.

items.title: Cupid net profit jumps 194% YoY to  ₹44 crore in Q1 as margins expand sharply; raises FY27 guidance
items.summary: Cupid reported a 194% YoY rise in net profit to  ₹44 crore and a 142% increase in revenue to  ₹157 crore for the June quarter, driven by strong growth in its international and domestic healthcare segments.

items.title: Akasa Air, AI Express say their B737 planes are not impacted by FAA directive
items.summary: Indian airlines Akasa Air and Air India Express confirmed their Boeing 737 fleets are not impacted by a recent FAA directive. This directive mandates inspections for potential fuselage cracks on certain Boeing 737 aircraft models. Akasa Air stated its young fleet will not reach inspection thresholds for many years. Air India Express also confirmed its approximately eighty Boeing 737 planes are unaffected by the order.

items.title: White House adviser declines to link Russia sanctions bill with India trade talks
items.summary: A proposed US sanctions bill targeting Russian oil buyers could affect trade talks with India. White House officials stated negotiators will decide any impact on ongoing discussions. Senators are advancing legislation that could impose tariffs on countries buying Russian energy. This measure aims to curb revenues supporting Russia's military actions in Ukraine. India and the US continue trade negotiations despite evolving tariff structures.

items.title: US cos see growing business interest in India as bilateral trade crosses $240 billion, says envoy Gor
items.summary: Sergio Gor, the US Ambassador, underscores the robust trust and teamwork that characterize US-India relations. With American businesses pursuing investments in India, bilateral trade has surged to over $240 billion. Additionally, India's military collaboration with the US is unmatched globally, while a remarkable 40% of the generic drugs consumed in the US are sourced from Indian manufacturers.

items.title: Raymond Realty Q1 net profit falls 19 pc to Rs 13.43 cr on higher expenses
items.summary: Raymond Realty experienced a 19% drop in profit for the quarter that ended in June, primarily due to increased operational costs that affected net earnings. Despite this, the total income rose to Rs 535.71 crore year-on-year. Moreover, the company reported impressive sales bookings of Rs 700 crore in the first quarter of FY27, representing a substantial increase from Rs 306 crore during the same period last year.

items.title: Gold hits seven-week high as weak U.S. jobs data dents rate hike bets
items.summary: Gold prices reached a seven-week high on Friday owing to surprising job losses in the United States that lowered the likelihood of upcoming rate hikes. This trend puts gold on track for its best weekly gain in seven months, as reduced interest rates boost its allure over yield-producing investments. Additionally, silver and platinum prices witnessed notable rises.

items.title: PFRDA approves 4 new pension funds, total count rises to 14; targets 35-40 crore NPS subscribers in 5 years
items.summary: Pension funds collect and invest money contributed by employees and employers to build a large financial pool with an endeavour to pay regular income streams to workers after they retire.

items.title: Shapoorji Pallonji's record bond issue finds a new class of investors
items.summary: Private wealth managers are parceling out pieces of the  ₹21,350 crore unrated, unlisted debt issue, selling investors a future payoff tied to Tata Sons' potential IPO.

items.title: India’s fiscal prudence through global shocks helping revive private investment, says DEA secretary
items.summary: Strong capital expenditure and strict fiscal discipline are crowding in private investment and maintaining growth around 7% amid global uncertainty, according to economic affairs secretary Anuradha Thakur.

items.title: India amends FDI rules to boost e-commerce for small businesses, artisans, farmers, and fishermen: Union Minister Piyush Goyal
items.summary: India has amended foreign direct investment regulations to boost e-commerce trade.  These changes will help small businesses, artisans, farmers, and fishermen access wider markets.  BRICS ministers discussed enhancing trade, investment, and industrial cooperation among member nations.  Discussions also focused on creating jobs through emerging technologies like artificial intelligence.  India aims to leverage e-commerce for connecting small-scale products with vast global markets.

items.title: Oil companies reject E20 fuel contamination claims, say nationwide tests found no quality issues
items.summary: State-run oil companies have dismissed concerns regarding E20 petrol quality. Extensive nationwide testing found no evidence of excessive moisture or chloride contamination. Fuel quality consistently remained within prescribed standards across the entire supply chain. Isolated instances of elevated chloride levels were immediately addressed and rectified. Consumers can confidently use E20 petrol, which meets all quality specifications.

items.title: SBI expects $10 billion FCNR(B) deposits to support lending, lower funding costs
items.summary: Speaking after the bank announced its first-quarter results, chairman Setty said SBI did not have a specific mobilization target, but the additional funds would help finance loan growth while reducing reliance on expensive bulk deposits.

items.title: Ola Electric’s revenue decline enters 7th quarter; company moves to settle Sebi probe
items.summary: Q1 revenue slumps 45% to  ₹455 crore as the EV maker seeks an early resolution on Sebi’s disclosure probe without admitting liability.

items.title: Airbnb shares surge 16% to 4-year high on Q2 beat; full-year outlook raised for second time
items.summary: Airbnb shares rose 16% to $176.20, a four-year high, following strong Q2 results with $3.6 billion revenue and increased bookings. The company reported robust growth in key markets and raised its fiscal outlook amid strong global travel demand despite geopolitical concerns.

items.title: Airbnb shares surge 15% to four-year high on raised forecast, AI gains
items.summary: Airbnb shares surged nearly 15% after the company raised its annual revenue growth forecast, citing resilient global travel demand and AI-driven efficiency. Better-than-expected quarterly revenue and lower customer-support costs reinforced investor confidence despite ongoing Middle East tensions.

items.title: Doximity shares soar 60% after CEO says its AI can outperform Anthropic
items.summary: Doximity shares surged after the healthcare platform highlighted the strong performance of its clinical AI, overshadowing an earnings miss. Investors cheered its AI capabilities, positioning the company as a specialised healthcare AI player despite mixed quarterly financial results.

items.title: India’s import dependence continues to be shaped by economic growth, manufacturing base: Govt to Parl
items.summary: India imported goods worth $131.63 billion from China in FY26, accounting for nearly 17% of total merchandise imports, the government told Rajya Sabha. It said Chinese imports include critical minerals, intermediate goods, capital equipment and technologies required by sectors such as clean energy, electronics, pharmaceuticals and infrastructure.

items.title: Hindalco beats Q1 estimates, remains cautious on bauxite auctions
items.summary: The Aditya Birla Group metal flagship reported an almost 75% year-on-year jump in the June-quarter net profit attributable to owners at  ₹7,013 crore.

items.title: 9 IPOs get Sebi approval as primary market pipeline gathers pace
items.summary: Sebi has approved IPOs of nine companies spanning engineering, travel technology, gaming, drones, paper, renewable energy and digital platforms. The approvals strengthen India’s IPO pipeline, with firms including Laxyo, Garuda Aerospace, PlaySimple Games, Rediff.com and Jakson Green preparing to list.

items.title: Pulse of the Street: Small-caps steal the show as equities extend gains
items.summary: The benchmarks gained 0.51% and 0.76%, respectively, during the week.

items.title: Sebi cuts inspection load for market intermediaries, shifts focus to risk-based checks
items.summary: Sebi has overhauled its inspection framework, reducing FY27 inspections to about one-third of last year’s level. The regulator will prioritise risk-based, joint inspections using alerts, complaints and market intelligence while easing compliance burdens for well-governed market intermediaries.

items.title: Wall Street surges as weak jobs data eases Fed rate hike fears, chip stocks jump
items.summary: As of 9:55 a.m. Eastern Time, the S&amp;P 500 rose 0.4%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.2%, and the Nasdaq Composite rose 1%.

items.title: SBI Q1 profit beats estimates on strong loan growth, asset quality
items.summary: SBI reported a 10% rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 21,121 crore, beating estimates on robust loan growth and higher net interest income. Improved asset quality, lower bad-loan provisions and strong credit demand offset weaker treasury income and slightly lower margins.

items.title: US stocks: US stocks rise as surprise payrolls decline cools rate-hike fears
items.summary: US stock markets opened higher on Friday after unexpected job losses.  The S&P 500 and Nasdaq saw gains at the opening bell.  This economic data raised doubts about a September interest rate hike.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average experienced a slight decline at the open.  Markets reacted to the latest employment figures released by the government.

items.title: Oil slips, heads for weekly loss as Hormuz deal uncertainty persists
items.summary: Oil prices declined as investors weighed prospects of reopening the Strait of Hormuz against persistent geopolitical risks. Markets also awaited US payrolls data, while uncertainty over Iran-related negotiations, shipping arrangements and regional security kept crude prices volatile despite easing supply concerns.

items.title: Onion, chicken prices make home-cooked meals costlier in July: Report
items.summary: Vegetarian thali costs rose four percent year-on-year in July. Non-vegetarian thali prices increased nine percent due to higher chicken costs. Onion and vegetable oil prices also contributed significantly to these increases. Potato and tomato prices fell, partially offsetting the overall rise. Month-on-month, vegetarian thali costs saw a two percent jump.

items.title: Onion, LPG prices push home-cooked thali costs up 9% in July: Crisil
items.summary: Onion prices rose 20% year-on-year, while vegetable oil and LPG cylinder prices increased 11% and 10%, respectively.

items.title: ₹71 to  ₹820: Multibagger stock turns  ₹1 lakh into  ₹11.5 lakh in five years. Do you own?
items.summary: ICE Make Refrigeration's stock soared 3,096% over five years, significantly increasing investor wealth. With retail investors owning 24% of the firm, the growth underscores the potential of carefully chosen stocks in the Indian market.

items.title: India, Russia discuss Vande Bharat, SJ-100 aircraft, UAVs to deepen industrial ties
items.summary: India and Russia reviewed industrial cooperation and explored new collaborations. Discussions focused on railway infrastructure and the Vande Bharat train project. Both nations also discussed opportunities in aircraft production and unmanned aerial systems. Cooperation in critical minerals and lithium mining was a key agenda item. The meeting concluded with a protocol reaffirming deepened bilateral economic ties.

items.title: PE majors Advent, EQT eye Pricol’s smart mobility tech biz
items.summary: Pricol Ltd's plan to spin off its driver information and connected vehicle solutions business has drawn interest from global private equity funds, underscoring the growing appeal of India's automotive electronics sector.

items.title: Hitachi Energy India Q1 Results: Net profit rises over twofold to Rs 294 crore
items.summary: Hitachi Energy India has displayed remarkable financial growth with a net profit soaring over 100% in the June quarter. The company reported a substantial increase in operational revenue compared to the previous year. With first-quarter orders reaching Rs 5,096.5 crore for FY27, the firm has achieved a record order backlog totaling Rs 32,222.1 crore, fueled by robust progress in energy transition and security sectors.

items.title: Indian bonds clock first weekly rise in five on dovish RBI, easing crude
items.summary: Indian government bonds finished the week with little change on Friday, yet celebrated their first gain in five weeks. A decline in oil prices and a calming tone from the central bank helped elevate demand for these bonds. The Reserve Bank of India opted to keep its repo rate steady, alleviating concerns over potential rate hikes in the near future.

items.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: S&P 500 closes at record as weak jobs data cools rate-hike fears
Gold alone isn't enough for your daughter’s Streedhan. Wealth manager Aarti Gupta explains why
items.summary: Wealth manager Aarti Gupta urged women to diversify beyond physical gold by building goal-based, multi-asset portfolios with SIPs, index funds and ETFs. She also advocated financial independence through personal bank accounts, emergency savings and shared household financial planning.

items.title: BSE Index Services launches BSE REITs Index. Here's everything you need to know
items.summary: BSE Index Services has launched the BSE REITs Index to track the performance of listed Real Estate Investment Trusts in India. The index comprises six REITs and has delivered an 18.54% one-year return on a total-return basis. Embassy Office Parks REIT has the highest weight at 32.18%.

items.title: More exporters leveraging benefits of free trade pacts: Govt
items.summary: In 2025-26, India's ten largest import partner countries were China, UAE, Russia, US, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Hong Kong, Switzerland, Singapore and Japan, as per govt data.

items.title: EIH shares drop 6% after the announcement of Q1FY27 results
items.summary: EIH shares fell 6% to  ₹307 after mixed Q1 earnings were announced, with a 52% QoQ profit decline despite a 3-fold YoY increase. The company plans significant expansion, signing agreements for six new luxury hotels aimed at capitalizing on growth opportunities.

items.title: Market wrap: TCS, SBI, M&M, Trent among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
items.summary: Indian equities ended lower as the Closing Auction Session continued creating divergence between Sensex and Nifty. Banking and financial stocks dragged benchmarks, while auto and IT outperformed. Analysts said Nifty’s 24,500 support remains crucial despite easing momentum and continued profit booking.

items.title: Rejected by IIT Madras Computer Science, MIT: How Aravind Srinivas built Perplexity AI
items.summary: Aravind Srinivas, 32, is now an inspiration to anyone facing rejection in competitive examinations, job applications, or other areas of life.

items.title: Apple prices set to stay high until September as Himachal yield drops 30%
items.summary: Climate-driven crop damage in Himachal Pradesh has driven up wholesale prices ahead of the Jammu &amp; Kashmir harvest, prompting traders to turn to imports to plug the supply gap.

items.title: India's forex reserves jump $10.5 billion to over two-month high of $692.87 billion as of July 31
items.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves saw a significant rise of over ten billion dollars. This surge pushed the nation's reserves to their highest point in more than two months. Foreign currency assets, the largest reserve component, increased substantially during the reporting week. Gold reserves also registered a notable gain, contributing to the overall increase. Special Drawing Rights and reserve position with the IMF also saw modest growth.

items.title: Ola Electric Q1 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 336 crore; revenue falls 45% YoY
items.summary: Ola Electric reported a narrower Q1 loss of Rs 336 crore as deliveries nearly doubled sequentially and revenue rebounded 72% from Q4. Improved market share, lower operating costs and progress in battery manufacturing supported the company's operational turnaround despite year-on-year revenue decline.

items.title: Aurobindo Pharma among 8 stocks hitting 52-week highs; surge up to 20% in a month
items.summary: Eight stocks from the BSE 200 index hit fresh 52-week highs, reaching their highest price levels in the past year, indicating strong investor interest, and potential upward momentum in the share price.

items.title: Vikram Solar Q1 net profit declines 85 pc to Rs 20 cr
items.summary: Vikram Solar experienced an astonishing 85 percent drop in profits for the June quarter, primarily attributable to increased expenses. On a positive note, the company's revenue from operations showed a healthy uptick during this period. In a strategic move, Vikram Solar has also greenlit the expansion of its wafer and ingot manufacturing facility, expected to be operational by fiscal year 2029.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp eyes electric motorcycle debut in 2027
items.summary: This marks a first for legacy two-wheeler makers, who have so far stayed away from entering the electric motorcycle segment, even as they work to develop the technology.

items.title: Lupin Q1 PAT rises 16 pc at Rs 1,417 cr
items.summary: Lupin Ltd has reported a remarkable sixteen percent surge in profit after tax for the first quarter, showcasing their continued success. The firm experienced considerable growth in consolidated total revenue from operations, largely driven by a staggering forty-two percent increase in sales in the US market. Moreover, sales in India rose nearly fourteen percent, reflecting strong domestic demand.

items.title: Premier Energies Q1 Result: Profit jumps 53% to Rs 472 crore
items.summary: Premier Energies reported remarkable growth, with profits soaring more than 53% in the latest quarter. The uptick in revenue can be attributed to robust demand across vital business sectors. The company has made significant strides in enhancing manufacturing, particularly in solar cells and modules. Moreover, plans are underway for new facilities to further elevate production capacities, as Premier Energies invests in expanding its solar initiatives and diversifying into new markets.

items.title: JK Tyre & Industries Q1 Results: Net profit tumbles 73% at Rs 44.09 crore
items.summary: In the first quarter of FY27, JK Tyre & Industries reported a staggering 73 percent decline in profits, primarily due to soaring raw material prices linked to the West Asia crisis. Their consolidated net profit plummeted to Rs 44.09 crore from Rs 163.35 crore year-on-year, even as revenue rose to Rs 3,946.24 crore. Notably, domestic volumes surged by 25 percent in both replacement and OE segments.

items.title: Arvind SmartSpaces Q1 Results: Profit zooms 8-fold to Rs 97 crore
items.summary: In the June quarter, Arvind SmartSpaces achieved remarkable results with an eight-fold rise in net profit. The company's total income surged to Rs 322.02 crore, while sales bookings more than doubled to Rs 432 crore. This exceptional performance stemmed from robust pre-sales and overall income growth, solidifying the firm's position as a leading player under the Lalbhai Group from Ahmedabad.

items.title: Bectors Food Q1 Results: Profit rises 25.5% to Rs 38.76 crore
items.summary: In the June quarter, Mrs Bectors Food Specialities reported a notable 25.53 percent increase in net profit. Their operating revenue surged by sixteen percent to reach Rs 548.75 crore, bolstered by a 19 percent growth in the biscuit sector and a remarkable 40 percent rise in the bakery segment. Additionally, the EBITDA margin saw an improvement of eighty basis points, reaching 13.1 percent.

items.title: Titan Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 63% to  ₹1,777 crore on steady jewellery demand; revenue rises 40%
items.summary: Titan, part of the Tata Group, reported strong FY27 results, with June quarter net profit rising 63% YoY to  ₹1,777 crore. Revenue from operations also surged 40% YoY to  ₹20,787 crore.

items.title: Titan Q1 Results: Profit soars 63% YoY to Rs 1,777 crore, total income surges 40%
items.summary: Titan Q1 Results: Consumer discretionary major Titan Ltd on Friday reported 63% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 1,777 crore in the first quarter, compared with Rs 1,091 crore in the last year quarter. Total income in the reporting period rose 40% YoY to Rs 20,753 crore.

items.title: RBI tightens loan recovery rules: EMI defaulters can't be harassed; strict norms on calls and phone-lock tactics
items.summary: Effective 1 January 2027, the new guidelines lay down detailed rules governing how lenders and recovery agents can communicate with borrowers, conduct field visits, and use technology to recover dues.

items.title: L&T Energy bags major offshore project orders from ONGC
items.summary: The awarded projects include the Pipeline Replacement Project and the Well Head Platforms Project

items.title: Hindalco Q1 results: Profit soars 75% YoY to record Rs 7,013 crore; revenue jumps 32%
items.summary: Hindalco Industries reported a record 75% year-on-year jump in June-quarter consolidated net profit to Rs 7,013 crore, driven by strong India aluminium and copper operations and a recovery at Novelis. Revenue rose 32% to an all-time high of Rs 84,825 crore, while EBITDA surged 73% to Rs 14,989 crore, reflecting robust operational performance despite exceptional expenses.

items.title: Won't ease ‘energy drink’ label 90-day deadline — FSSAI says companies should ‘be happy not prosecuting…’: Report
items.summary: In July, the FSSAI privately gave the companies 90 days to drop “energy drink” or any similar description from high-caffeine beverages, saying there were no Indian standards for such products and that using that term breached regulations.

items.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 7 August: Bajaj Finance, Navin Fluorine, Trent, Tata Capital, Swiggy among top losers
items.summary: The Indian stock market struggled on August 7, with the Nifty 50 down 0.32% and the Sensex declining 0.59%. Concerns over a potential peace deal in the Middle East and financial sector weaknesses led to mixed performance among broader markets and sector indices.

items.title: EXIM Bank to be implementing agency for interest subvention support for exporters: DGFT
items.summary: The commerce ministry announced EXIM Bank will implement export credit interest subvention. This transition from the Reserve Bank of India is effective April 1, 2026. EXIM Bank will manage all operational aspects and claim settlements. The Reserve Bank of India will process claims for the January to March 2026 quarter.

items.title: RBI proposal to curb NBFC revolving credit rattles markets
items.summary: Shares of Bajaj Finance, Tata Capital and Cholamandalam Investment fall 5.8%, 3.2% and 3.8%, respectively, on the NSE.

items.title: Relief for Airtel and Vi as Supreme Court refuses stay on high court's one-time spectrum charge ruling
items.summary: The top court agreed to hear the government's appeal against the verdict quashing retrospective dues, but refused to halt the release of  ₹3,300 crore in bank guarantees to the telecom operators.

items.title: Multibaggers: 12 stocks skyrocketed up to 925% in 6 months; here's how retail investors bet on them
items.summary: Thirty-four BSE stocks doubled in six months, with 12 delivering returns of 169% to 923%. Retail investors raised stakes in several multibaggers while booking profits in others during June 2026 quarter.

items.title: Alphabet, Meta Platforms to SK Hynix: What does the AI trade bubble burst mean for the Indian stock market?
items.summary: Experts believe contra-AI trade may benefit Indian stock market once the crowded AI positioning across global markets begins to take a pause

items.title: CMS Info Systems bets on tech and payment solutions to drive next growth phase
items.summary: The company aims to double its tech unit's revenue share to over 20% by FY30 by expanding AI surveillance and payment solutions into retail, quick commerce, and EV charging.

items.title: Michael Bloomberg: America needs to repeal rather than just suspend a rusty old shipping law
items.summary: An old law framed to shield the US shipping industry, the Jones Act of 1920, was suspended after the Iran war broke out. That it’s an economic dead-weight is amply clear now that fresh evidence is in. So why not jettison it for good?

items.title: Relief for Dabur as high court stays FSSAI order on ‘100% pure’ claims
items.summary: &nbsp;The court said prima facie it appears the food regulator should not have passed the prohibitory order without first giving Dabur an opportunity to be heard.

items.title: Global equity funds extend inflow streak to 11 weeks as earnings optimism lifts risk appetite
items.summary: Global equity funds extended their inflow streak to 11 weeks, attracting $21.15 billion in the week ended August 5. Strong corporate earnings and easing crude prices boosted risk appetite. European and Asian equity funds led regional inflows, while emerging market equities saw their strongest weekly inflows in over five months.

items.title: India reviewing bilateral investment treaty overhaul to boost foreign investment: Official
items.summary: India is reviewing its bilateral investment treaty model soon.  The cabinet will decide on changes to attract more foreign capital.  This review comes as India negotiates new pacts with developed nations.  Indian industry bodies also seek faster dispute resolution for investors.  The nation aims to boost foreign direct investment compared to peers.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp shares climb 4.5%, hit 5-month high after strong June-quarter results
items.summary: Hero MotoCorp shares surged 4.5% to  ₹5,800 after a strong June-quarter, with revenues up 36% year-on-year at  ₹13,126 crore. Motorcycle and scooter sales rose 23% YoY, with a notable profit increase, despite previous quarter's one-time gain. The stock has recovered 21% in five weeks.

items.title: SBI share price climbs 4% after Q1 profit jumps 10% YoY, beats estimates
items.summary: SBI shares rose sharply on Friday after the lender reported a 10% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 21,121 crore, beating Street estimates. Net interest income rose 15% to Rs 46,992 crore, while total business crossed Rs 110 trillion. The stock remains 9% below its 52-week high.

items.title: RBI allows gradual device restrictions for EMI defaults, eases recovery agent disclosure norms
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will permit lenders to restrict devices bought on EMI financing.  These restrictions will be gradual and only after a loan is significantly overdue.  Incoming calls and emergency functions will remain accessible to borrowers.  Disclosure requirements for recovery agents have also been eased by the central bank.  The new rules will be implemented from January 1, 2027.

items.title: India's latest trade deals to open new global markets for Arunachal farmers, manufacturers: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: New trade deals offer Arunachal Pradesh farmers and manufacturers global market access.  Nine agreements spanning thirty-eight countries create wider export opportunities for producers.  These pacts aim to lower tariffs and reduce trade barriers for Indian exporters.  Arunachal Pradesh's agriculture and horticulture sectors hold significant export potential.  Strengthening infrastructure and market linkages will boost the state's export growth.

items.title: Indian July consumer inflation likely edged higher on food prices: Reuters poll
items.summary: India’s retail inflation likely rose to 4.50% in July from 4.38% in June, according to a Reuters poll of 40 economists, marking a second straight month above the RBI’s 4% medium-term target.

items.title: Lok Sabha passes MSME Development Amendment Bill without debate
items.summary: The Bill seeks to address the current challenges faced by the MSME sector by improving the administrative structure and facilitating payment mechanisms

items.title: SBI Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 10.2% YoY to  ₹21,121 crore, NII up 15%
items.summary: SBI Q1 Results: SBI reported a 10.23% YoY rise in Q1 net profit to  ₹21,121.22 crore and an interest income of  ₹46,992 crore, up 14.88%. Gross advances grew 18.6%, while total business surpassed  ₹110 lakh crore. The bank improved asset quality with lowered GNPA and NPA ratios.

items.title: A surge of app lending is pushing Indians into a debt trap as they borrow more to repay old loans
items.summary: Loans at an annual rate of 36%? It gets even more usurious in some cases as repayments devour the earnings of those who get tempted by easy app credit to fund consumption and repay loans. This market is a house of cards in need of intervention.

items.title: SBI Q1 Results: Standalone profit rises 10% YoY to Rs 21,121 crore, beats estimates
items.summary: State Bank of India reported a ten percent year-on-year net profit growth.  Its net interest income also saw a fifteen percent rise during the quarter.  Total business crossed one hundred ten trillion rupees, with deposits exceeding sixty trillion.  Advances grew nineteen percent year-on-year, driven by broad-based loan segment expansion.  Margin improvements were noted, defying earlier analyst expectations of pressure.

items.title: AI frenzy spooks investors but JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon says spending boom likely to pay off. Here's why
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon believes massive capital expenditure in artificial intelligence by hyperscalers will ultimately pay off despite market anxiety. Speaking to CNBC, Dimon noted that AI infrastructure demand is driving US economic growth and GDP, though individual data centre project risks require careful case-by-case analysis.

items.title: Optimystix Entertainment IPO Day 1: Issue booked 34% so far. Check GMP, issue details, key dates
items.summary: Optimystix Entertainment IPO runs from August 7 to August 11, with a price band of  ₹166-175 per share. The company, known for its TV productions and films, anticipates a strong listing on August 14, following positive grey market trends and steady financial growth.

items.title: Suzlon Energy shares rise after US judge directs Pentagon to lift wind project freeze
items.summary: Suzlon Energy shares rose after a U.S. judge ordered the Pentagon to lift its freeze on reviewing onshore wind projects. According to Reuters, U.S. District Judge Karin Immergut granted a preliminary injunction sought by renewable energy groups, who said the freeze had caused a "total halt" in wind project development across the country.

items.title: SC lets Delhi HC continue hearing govt's $2.31 bn claim against Reliance in offshore oilfields dispute
items.summary: The Centre claims Reliance recovered costs in the Panna-Mukta and Tapti offshore oilfields beyond the contractual limit, allowing it to retain more revenue than it was entitled to

items.title: Closing Auction Session: Why Sebi says the new framework is better than VWAP
items.summary: Sebi has defended the new Closing Auction Session (CAS), saying it offers better price discovery and execution certainty than the earlier VWAP-based system. The regulator said CAS aligns Indian markets with global practices and aims to reduce price disruption. Traders, however, remain concerned about unpredictable closing prices and risk management.

items.title: Ixigo posts record Q1 profit, but stock tumbles 9%. Here's what worried Dalal Street
items.summary: Ixigo shares fell nearly 9% despite the online travel company reporting its highest-ever quarterly profit in Q1FY27. The stock came under pressure after brokerages turned cautious, citing continued investments in hotels, AI and other growth initiatives that could weigh on near-term profitability. Shares later pared losses but remained down over 8% during Friday’s session.

items.title: India on track to exceed key fundraising goal on state-firm stake sales
items.summary: India is poised to achieve its divestment aspirations this fiscal year, with enhanced momentum in stake sales and asset monetisation. Although increased fertiliser costs and fuel subsidies pose a challenge to public financial stability due to regional disputes, the country has already garnered over $5.5 billion from diverse stake sales.

items.title: US envoy Sergio Gor meets key industry leaders to advance US-India collaborations
items.summary: US Ambassador Sergio Gor met industry leaders and government officials on Friday. Discussions focused on strengthening US-India collaborations across advanced manufacturing and technology sectors. The critical minerals sector was also a key area for enhancing strategic supply chains between nations. Assistant Secretary Wesley R. Brooks highlighted opportunities in recycling and recovery of critical minerals. The US-India Business Council hosted a roundtable on critical minerals recycling and recovery.

items.title: Godrej Consumer shares slide 4% after Q1 margin falls amid commodity inflation; Rs 5/share dividend declared
items.summary: Godrej Consumer Products shares fell 4.3% after the FMCG major reported its June quarter results. Consolidated net profit rose 12% year-on-year to Rs 505 crore, while revenue from operations increased 18% to Rs 4,225 crore. Despite healthy growth, the stock declined as investors reacted to the quarterly performance.

items.title: Cummins India faces margin, valuation hurdles despite robust demand
items.summary: Cummins India's Q1 margin disappointed despite healthy revenue growth. Pricing actions, export recovery and rising data centre demand will be key to restoring profitability.

items.title: Aegeus Technologies IPO allotment to be finalised today. Here's GMP, how to check status online
items.summary: The GMP of Aegeus Technologies IPO ahead of allotment is  ₹12, according to Investorgain.

items.title: Adani Green Energy shares can rally up to 23%. Why Axis Capital, Elara initiated coverage
items.summary: Brokerages Axis Capital and Elara Capital initiated coverage on Adani Green Energy, citing its ambitious plan to expand renewable energy capacity to 50 GW and strong long-term growth prospects. The firms see up to 23% upside, backed by robust capacity additions, improving cash flows and India's accelerating clean energy transition.
